# Fanfarr v0.5.15

Fanfarr finds theme music for a Plex library, writes it beside the media as a
local `theme.mp3`, and keeps a permanent record of what it did and why.

## Authorization is no longer switched off

Nineteen internal calls passed `authorize?: false`, which turns every policy off
for the duration of one call. Ash's own guidance calls that the wrong tool,
because the exemption cannot be reviewed, logged, or told apart from a mistake --
and it was not cosmetic here: `Accounts.User` and `Accounts.Token` do have
policies, so account seeding and the auth checks were skipping the policy solver
entirely, including the operations that create and destroy login credentials.

Internal work now names a system actor, `Fanfarr.SystemActor.new(:context)`, and
the two resources that should honour it say so with a bypass policy. The two
calls a person actually makes carry `current_user`, because that is who is
asking. One test fails the build if the old pattern reappears anywhere in `lib/`,
and another proves the actor is checked rather than decorative: with no actor,
the resource returns `Ash.Error.Forbidden`.

## The whole suite runs in 38 seconds

The database tests cannot share one SQLite file. It has a single writer, so
concurrent tests collide rather than queue -- which is why they were serial, and
why the gate took a minute. They now run as four processes with a database each:
the same 856 tests, in about 38 seconds. CI takes the same path.

## Dependencies are current

Everything is updated except `assent`, which is held back by
`ash_authentication`'s own requirement rather than ours. That includes four 0.x
minors -- `ash_sql`, `ash_oban`, `ecto_sqlite3`, `exqlite` -- and two our
constraints had been blocking: `phoenix_live_dashboard` 0.9 and `dns_cluster`
0.3.

`daisyui` is gone rather than updated. It was fetched on every build while
nothing loaded it: no Tailwind plugin, and a test asserting no daisyui class
names remain in the markup.

The update moved `lucide`, which renames icons between releases, and `trash-2`
no longer exists. Three call sites now use `trash` -- the icon test caught that
before it shipped as three invisible buttons.

## Blank backup settings mean the defaults

The Backups card has always accepted blank fields; what was missing was anything
saying what they do. With the switch on and every field blank, the interval is
24 hours, keep is 7, the size cap is off, and a snapshot is due and enqueued.
Blank is deliberately not the same as `0`, which turns the schedule off, and
both are asserted so a later change cannot quietly merge the two.

## Also

- The Plex card's **Test** button has tests, including that testing does not
  save what you typed.
- The Ash JSON API is deleted. It was mounted and unauthenticated while serving
  nothing, and cost two dependencies and a Swagger UI for an empty API.

## Upgrading

Pull the new image and restart; the database migrates itself on boot. Nothing
needs configuring.
